sql: SELECT TOP 10 s.ShippingCode AS shippingCode, s.ShippingName AS shippingName, s.Description AS expectedShippingOptionName, s.ShippingId AS shippingId FROM dbo.ZnodeShipping s INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeShippingTypes st ON st.ShippingTypeId = s.ShippingTypeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalShipping pship ON pship.ShippingId = s.ShippingId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pship.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = pship.PublishStateId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND s.ShippingCode = @shippingCode AND s.IsActive = @isActive AND st.Name = @shippingType AND st.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState ORDER BY s.ShippingId
